Yes, you are right about that.

In return, I will hand you titles we never released underground before.

Drawing attention right now is not a wise move.
The cops are fine. We have our man on the inside.
One more thing—stop selling Muranishi's underground videos.
Now that one is an order. Count on you.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Casual, blunt contraction of あなた used between intimates or in heated speech.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.

meanings.en: nothing more than (after past verb); up to
